translation.name: No Sigar Kunubus tika ma Ira Ninge na Lotu

book.name: JON
book.title: No Tahut na Hinhinawas JON ga Pakat Ie.

content: Jisas ga hanut uram tano Lukara na Palpalih.
Io namur ta kaiken, Jisas ga hanan hurbit tano hanuo Galili. Pa ga sip bia na hanan hurbit haan narako tano hanuo Iudeia kanong ira Iudeia kaia diet ga sisilih wara bubu bing ie.

Iesen bia no Lukara na Palpalih gar na Iudeia gate hutet, io kaik, ira tasine Jisas diet gom tange tana, “I tahut bia nu haan laah mekai ma nu haan urau Iudeia waing ira num bulu na harausur diet naga nes ira num pinapalim.
Taie tikai pa na suhe ing i gilgil bia ing i sip bia da nunurei. Taie. Bia u la gilgil kaike ira linge, i tahut bia nu haminas ugu ta ira tunotuno bakut.”
Ira tasine diet ga tange hokaiken kanong diet mah, diet pa ga nurnur tana.
Ma bia ing Jisas ga hadade huo, ga tange ta diet, “No nugu pakana bung pai hanuat at baak. Iesen ira pakana bung bakut i la haruat taar ta muat.
Taie ta burena bia ira tunotuno ta iakan ra ula hanuo diet na malentakuane muat. Iesen diet malentakuane iau kanong iau hinawas utano tutun ta diet bia ira udiet magingin i sakena.
Kaia. Muat na hanut uram tano Lukara. Iau pa ni hanut kanong no nugu pakana bung pai hanuat at baak.”
Ma bia gate tange huo taar ta diet, ga kiskis um kaia Galili.
Iesen bia ira tasine diet gate hanut uram tano Lukara, Jisas mah um ga mur hut. Ma pa ga hanuat palai kaia, ga munmun haan at mon.
Io, kaia tano Lukara, ira Iudeia diet ga naanaas haan tana, diet gom tirtiri bia, “Ie he um iakano tunotuno?”
Ma a tamat na matanaiabar kaia, diet ga harmurungo utana. Ari diet ga tangtange bia, “A tahut na tunotunoi.” Ma ari mes diet ga tangtange, “Taie. Aie tikai ing i lam harango ira tunotuno.”
Iesen bia taie tikai pa ga ianga palai utana kanong diet ga burut harbasia ta diet.
Diet ga tur harpaleng bia Jisas aie no Mesaia bia taie.
Ma bia no Lukara gate haan nalamin, Jisas ga haan laka uram tano tamat na hala na lotu, gaam haburen hauhausur.
Ma ira Iudeia diet ga karup, diet gaam tiri bia, “Hohe tutun bia iakan ra tunotuno i manga nunure ra haleng ma pa ga harausur?”
Ma bia ga hadade huo, Jisas ga tange hoken: “Ira harausur iau hauhausur me, pai nugu at. Iesen anuno nong ga tule iau ukai.
Bia sige nong i sip bia na mur ira sinisip ta God, aie at na nunure leh ira nugu harausur bia makatiga ho God bia iau iangianga bia mon tano nugu lilik.
Sige nong i iangianga at ma no nuno dadas, i la hatatik habal at ie. Iesen sige nong i sip bia na hatatik nong ga tulei, a tutun na tunotunoi, ma taie ta harabota tano uno nilon.
Muat nunure tar at mon bia Moses te tar ira harkurai tane God ta muat. Sen bia taie tikai ta muat pai la murmur kaike ra harkurai. Wara bih tutun at kaik muat gi sisilih bia muat naga bu bing iau?”
Io, no tamat na matanaiabar diet ga tange tana, “Ah, a sakana tanuo i te sosoha taam! Sige i wara bubu bing ugu?”
Jisas ga tange ta diet, “Iau ga gil tiga linge mon ma muat te karup tana.
Iesen muat la kutkut ira nat na bulu ra Bung na Sinangeh kanong Moses ga tar iakano harkurai ta muat (sen bia pai Moses tutun ga hatahun ie, ira hintubu muat at menalua tana.)

Bia ing i tale bia muat na kut tiga nat na bulu tano Bung na Sinangeh waing muat pa na lake no harkurai tane Moses, io, wara bih kaik muat gi ngalngaluan taar tagu kanong iau gate halangalanga tikai ta ira uno minaset bakut tano Bung na Sinangeh?
Waak muat nas pukusane ira linge hoing ira numuat ninaas mon. Taie. Muat na nes kilam tiga linge hoing aie tutun at huo.”
Io, ari matanaiabar aram Ierusalem diet ga tangtange, “Iakan at mon ra tunaan nong di wara bubu bing ie. Naka?
Iesen, nas baak! Iakaiken mon i iangianga ra haruat. Iesen diet pai tange tiga linge utana. Ma ira lualua dak diet nunure bia a tutun bia aie no Mesaia?
Iesen bia, dahat nunure ta mon ing iakan ra tunotuno aie mekaia. Ma bia no Mesaia na hanuat, taie tikai pa na nunure bia i hanuat meh.”

Ma bia Jisas ga hauhausur aram tano hanuo na tamat na hala na lotu gar na Iudeia, ga kakongane bia, “Muat lik mon bia muat nunure tar iau, ma bia iau meh. Iau pa ga lik leh at iau bia ni hanuat ukai. Iesen nong ga tule iau ukai i gil ra tutun. Muat pai nunure ie.
Iesen iau nunure tar ie kanong iau mekaia ho ie ma aie ga tule iau ukai.”
Ma bia ga tange huo diet ga walar bia diet na palim kawasei, iesen taie tikai pa ga sigirei kanong no uno pakana bung pa ga hanuat baak.

Iesen a haleng ta diet ta iakano tamat na matanaiabar, diet ga nurnur tana. Ma diet gaam tange, “Bia no Mesaia na hanuat, i tutun bia pa na gil ari dadas na hakilang ing na haleng ta iakanin ra tunotuno. Naka?”

Ma ira Parisi diet ga hadade ira matanaiabar diet ga harharmurungo hokaiken utana. Io, diet ma ira tamat na ut na pakila lotu, diet ga tule se ari umri ing diet la harbalaurai tano tamat na hala na lotu bia diet na palim kawase Jisas.
Jisas ga tange, “Iau pa ni kis talona tika ma muat. Taie. Namur dahin iau ni haan uram ho nong ga tule iau ukai.
Muat na sisilih tagu iesen muat pa na nes leh iau. Ma ing iau ni kis kaia, muat pai tale bia muat na haan ukaia.”

Ma ira Iudeia diet ga tange harbasiane ta diet hoken: “Iakan ra tunotuno i wara hinahaan uhe kaik dahat pa naga nes leh ie? Hohe, na haan sukun dak iakan ra udahat hanuo, naga kis tika ma diet ing diet pai Iudeia ma naga hausur diet?
Ga tange bia dahat na sisilih tana iesen dahat pa na nes leh ie, ma bia ing na kis kaia, dahat mah, dahat pai tale bia dahat na haan ukaia. I kukuraina tutun hohe kaik gaam tange huo?”
Io, no bung na hapataamne no lukara aie no tamat na bung sakit. Ma ta iakano bung, Jisas ga taman tut, gaam kakongane bia, “Sige tiga nong i maruk, i tahut bia na haan tupas iau ma na mom.
Sige nong i nurnur tagu, ira taah na nilon na sal laah meram narako tana hoing ira nianga tane God di ga pakat i tange huo.”

Bia Jisas ga ianga huo, ga tange nuruan no Halhaliana Tanuo bia diet ing diet ga nurnur ta Jisas diet na hatur kawase ie. Ta iakano pakana bung God pa ga tar baak no Tanuo kanong no minarine Jisas pa ga hanuat puasa baak.
Ma bia ari ta ira matanaiabar diet ga hadade ing ga tange huo, io, diet ga tange bia, “A tutun, iakan ra tunotuno, aie at mon no tangesot nong di ga kukubus taar utana.”
Ari a mes diet ga tange, “Aie no Mesaia.” Ma ari at baak diet ga tiri bia, “No Mesaia na hanuat hohe me Galili?
Pai haruat huo kanong ira pakpakat ta God i tange bia no Mesaia na hanuat tano huntunaan ta Dawit. Ma na hanuat meram Betlehem, no taman tane Dawit.”
Io kaik, ira matanaiabar diet gom tur harpaleng wara gaiene Jisas.
Ari ta diet ga wara palpalim kawasei, iesen taie tikai pa ga sigirei.
Ira lualua gar na Iudeia diet pa ga nurnur bia Jisas no Mesaia.
Io, ira umri ing diet la harbalaurai tano tamat na hala na lotu diet ga tapukus taar ta ira tamat na ut na pakila lotu ma ira Parisi. Ma ira lualua diet ga tange ta diet, “Warah muat pai lamus ie?”
Ma ira umri diet ga balu diet bia, “Taie tutun at bia tikai i la iangianga ho iakan ra tunotuno.”
Ma ira Parisi diet ga tange balik ta diet, “Pai lamus habato muat mah, naka?
Muat pai lik mah bia tari lualua ma bia tari Parisi diet nurnur tana, naka?
Taie! Sen bia iakan ra tamat na matanaiabar mon diet te gil huo. Iesen diet pai nunure ira harkurai tane God. Kaik God i te tule bingbing diet.”

Io, Nikodimas tikai ta diet ira Parisi mah. Aie mon nong ga haan tupas baak Jisas nalua. Ma ga tange ta diet, “Ma ira udahat kaba harkurai, dahat pai la kurkure tikai menalua bia dahat pai hadade baak ie wara palpalai ta ing i te gil.”
Io, diet ga balui, “Augu mah pau meram Galili, nah? Ma nu was timaan baak ira nianga ta God, nugu nes tupas bia tiga tangesot pa na hanuat meram Galili.”
[Io, diet ga haan taar ta ira udiet hala tikatikai.
